title: Power series over a Noetherian ring are Noetherian
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $n\geq0$. Then the formal power series ring $R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] is Noetherian.
